body:
Instead of renaming every option, please use `rename_all=pascal_case`:

```suggestion
#[serde(try_from = "String")]
pub enum GradleVersionStrategy {
    #[serde(rename = "properties")]
    WrapperProperties,
    #[serde(rename = "executable")]
    Executable,
}
```

body:
This doesn't seem to do anything:
```suggestion
```
I would avoid executing files from the current working directory unless explicitly configured to do so.
Please avoid searching files recursively, unless the module is configured to do this. For the base level, please try checking the scan results if a `gradle` folder exists.

99.9% of gradle projects use the gradle wrapper, so most of the users don't even have gradle installed, also the versions can differ from project to project, so displaying the globally installed version would be wrong.

body: I'm just concerned about running executables from potentially untrusted directories.
Oh yeah, I didn't think of that.

On a second look, this may start failing if `gradle-` shows up elsewhere in the URL, this should be a bit less brittle:
```suggestion
    let version = wrapper_properties
        .lines()
        .find(|line| line.starts_with("distributionUrl="))?
        .rsplit_once('/')?
        .1
        .strip_prefix("gradle-")?
        .split_once('-')?
        .0;
```
